hypothesis: Bounded scalar producers whose integer control induction starts away from zero, starts at a runtime invariant, advances by a constant nonunit step, descends, wraps, or uses a relational/swapped exit can be split without changing their control. An independent ordinal separates scratch/consumer indexing from the original IV. This extends the accepted branch-only acyclic scalar path before ordinary vectorization legality, retaining independently chosen stage VFs and no new profitability model, pressure/depth/reduction-count threshold or requirement that the original loop be vectorizable.
semantics: Identify the one control PHI directly compared (as either operand, before or after its increment) with an invariant in the unique exiting latch. Ordinary InductionDescriptor::isInductionPHI, using ScalarEvolution rather than predicated SE and no assumptions, must recognize an integer affine recurrence for this loop with invariant start, constant nonzero step and a binary backedge value. Other header PHIs still pass the unchanged integer-add / ordered float-or-double-add reduction recognizer and use restrictions. Pointer/FP controls, variable/zero steps and nonlinear recurrences do not acquire support. The existing unique-latch, simplify-form, dedicated-exit, LCSSA and branch-only DAG checks remain. Every producer iteration therefore reaches the latch exactly once. For a noncanonical unconditional producer, insert ordinal=0 in the header, increment once at the latch, store distinct contribution values at ordinal, and export the completed value through a single-input PHI in the dedicated producer exit / consumer preheader. The consumer starts at zero, adds one and compares with that export, so it performs exactly N ordered updates, independent of original start, stride, predicate, comparison operand order or branch polarity. Preserve the original producer IV, flags, compare, branch polarity and entry guards; only redirect its exiting edge. Entry bypasses cannot reach the consumer. The old zero/one equality case remains a small proven equivalent: its original IV is already the ordinal and its invariant equality bound is the completed count. Only that canonical case clones the original induction/control for the consumer. Conditional compaction retains exactly the existing separate single-triangle/diamond participation proof, shared arm and counter; P<=N values are stored in original participant order and exactly P are consumed. P=0 still exports the starts without any reduction arithmetic or inactive operation. No extra full-iteration ordinal is needed for compaction. The scalar path bounds backedges by ordinary SE's constant maximum and, when an exact unpredicated count is available, also by its unsigned range after SE.applyLoopGuards applies only existing entry guards. It uses the smaller proven bound, widens before adding one, and checks the completed count fits both uint64_t and the original integer counter type. The range refinement preserves runtime-start/end correlation that relational constant-maximum analysis can lose, without adding any predicate or emitted guard. It neither constructs nor expands a runtime trip-count expression and no longer unnecessarily requires expansion safety for an expression it never emits. For all defined executions N<=M; before a store 0<=ordinal<N<=M, and completed<=M fits the count type, proving each added nuw increment and count export. Checked allocation-size multiplication, alignment addition and signed pointer-index ceiling prove the casts are value-preserving and every scratch GEP remains within its constant array. Narrow count 256 in i8 rejects even though the original control may wrap. All rejections precede mutation. Reduction state use restrictions continue to prohibit influence on producer control/contributions or observations of partial reductions. Other live-outs, real memory effects, volatile/atomic accesses, unsafe calls and strictfp/constrained FP remain rejected. Contributions and calls remain on their original paths, with no rereads or speculative evaluation. Reduction updates are cloned with flags and FP operand/iteration order intact; the separate fission FP-reordering option adds no relaxation to this path. Independent ordinary LV may choose scalar, vector and tail stages afterwards. Executable verification is requested, not claimed run: ten exact-source-location positive targets are checked against their original control/flags/edges and scratch addresses; actual transformed scalar-remainder consumers are executed against untouched original IR and independent C formulas. Non-NaN FP bits (including signed zero), NaN classification, shared contributions, null inactive FP inputs, inactive zero divisors, negative divisors, aliases, canaries, input preservation, scratch reuse, exact producer/header/latch/participant/vector/tail counts and enclosing-loop future-row dependences are required. Original control N=0..65 plus 66/UINT64_MAX bypasses and compact P=0..65 are exercised; runtime starts include INT64_MIN/-1000/-33/-1/0/31/INT64_MAX, including an unmasked modular-control case. One and two ordinary vectorizer invocations, both fission FP-option settings and fixed host vscales 1/2/4/8/32 are requested. Three further actual scalar-stage boundary cases execute exactly 1,255,16384 trips after one and two LV invocations against original IR and independent scalar formulas. Default EVL/VP and uninstrumented remainder IR receive RVV machine verification only. The checker accepts n as an equivalent affine consumer count only for fixtures whose entire original entry/control arithmetic is checked and proves N=n; compact control remains exclusively tied to its proven P exports.
costs: Let M be the unconditionally proven maximum trip count, N the actual producer iterations, P the actual compact participants, and S the summed allocation sizes of distinct contribution SSA values. Bounded static scratch is M*S plus ABI alignment accounting, unchanged checked uint64/pointer-index arithmetic and the default 65536-byte per-candidate ceiling. It is allocated in the function entry and can reserve stack even on an entry bypass. Nine mixed affine fixtures have four reductions sharing three arrays (65*i32,65*double,65*float), 1044 accounted bytes including 4 padding bytes. Logical scratch stores=16*N bytes and loads=16*N bytes (32*N total), or 16*P in each direction for the compact fixture. The enclosing fixture uses 784 accounted bytes (65*i32,65*double plus 4 padding bytes), reused per row, with 12*N bytes in each direction per row, not capacity multiplied by row count. Capacity boundary cases reserve 4/1020/65536 bytes for 1/255/16384 i32 contributions and logically transfer 8*N bytes total, including 131072 bytes at the full default capacity. A new noncanonical unconditional producer adds one integer PHI and one scalar add per iteration plus one LCSSA count PHI. The consumer uses one zero-based PHI, one add, one equality test and one branch per scalar iteration, just as an ordinary counted consumer; it does not clone the original nonzero/strided control. The old canonical equality path adds no producer counter. Compaction retains one count add per participant, header/latch merge PHIs, count export and the existing P=0 guard; it adds no second ordinal. There are no additional original-input rereads, duplicated producer operations, recomputed contributions, mask arrays, alias/SCEV guards, loop versioning, dynamic allocation or unbounded storage. Existing normal-LV vector/tail guards remain. Compile-time work is one O(H) header-PHI scan with direct two-operand control matching and the existing unconditional induction/SCEV analyses; a small maximum-count helper with an optional existing-loop-guard rewrite/range query replaces scalar use of the exact-trip expansion analysis. It reuses LLVM's existing bounded guard collection and SCEV range machinery rather than adding a solver. Existing O(B+E)-time/O(B)-space CFG admission and instruction/use scans and full dominator recalculation remain. No path enumeration, generalized dependence machinery or profitability model is introduced. Regression fixtures and validation probes increase test cost only. Physical stack layout/cache traffic, register pressure, RVV execution and speedup have not been measured.
limitations: The worker did not build LLVM, run a compiler (including host compilation), execute lit/unit/checker/try.sh tests or run target code. Only source/evidence reading, file generation/edits and read-only diff/whitespace review were performed. Fresh harness compilation and every requested check are pending; historical accepted-head results do not validate this revision. No original-corpus coverage gain, direction maturity or performance improvement is claimed. Unconditional bounds depend on ordinary LLVM SCEV proof strength; a finite loop that needs predicates/runtime checks, a bound too wide for the original count type, the scratch/pointer-index ceilings, or a direct-latch comparison shape the recognizer does not support still rejects. Only one integer affine control is distinguished; additional non-reduction recurrences, pointer/FP inductions, arbitrary recurrences, early exits, internal cycles, switches, unsafe calls/effects, unsupported live-outs, distinct/incompatible participation streams and strict/constrained FP are not broadened. The ordinary loop worklist generally remains innermost. Scratch remains full-trip, untiled and capped per candidate rather than across a whole function. Fixture-specific structural/provenance assertions are not a general IR equivalence solver. Host fixed-vscale scalar-remainder execution is not RVV target execution. EVL/VP is machine-verified code generation only. No benchmarks, frozen corpus, harness, other worktree, common build checkout, compiler binaries or Git index/history/refs were changed, and no unfinished d2 work was integrated.
test_expectations: No existing correctness or diagnostic expectation was removed or weakened, and no previously rejected fixture was rewritten into a positive. The previously unsupported affine-control class is represented by new positive fixtures, with new unproved/feedback/effect/live-out/participation/zero-step/variable-step/nonlinear/pointer/FP/strictfp rejection siblings. Old canonical equality, acyclic and compact assertions remain. Scalar-only RUNs include enormous existing reduction/chain/pressure heuristic options to demonstrate those are not prerequisites. The affine i8 maximum deliberately permits wrapping original control while preserving all flags; only its private count must not wrap. Its 256-trip sibling intentionally rejects trip-count-overflow and retains its original loop. Exact source-location Selected and producer/consumer VF remarks are required at scalar-affine.c:{12,22,32,42,52,62,72,82,92,102}:3, not another function or inner/helper loop. New reject and boundary remarks have their own exact original-loop locations. ScalarEvolution during ordinary LV may replace a completed ordinal's count by the equivalent n or by a single-input latch LCSSA forwarding PHI; the new checker verifies original control, actual count export and the exact affine equivalence before accepting those names. Compaction's separate P count/result provenance assertions are unchanged.
